title: Application deadline
passage: We still have until Monday to apply, do we not? A. The appliance is under warranty. B. Monday is usually our busiest day. C. They brought the deadline forward to Friday.
passageZh:
我們的申請期限仍到星期一，對吧？
A. 這台電器仍在保固期內。
B. 星期一通常是我們最忙的一天。
C. 他們把截止日提前到星期五了。
audioScript: We still have until Monday to apply, do we not? A. The appliance is under warranty. B. Monday is usually our busiest day. C. They brought the deadline forward to Friday.
